focus: v14 safety, CLASSIFY1, physical POI sizes, manual and measured geometry

findings.description: Measured or manual geometry can exclude a saved worldAnchor. Actual v14 import accepts a measured 0.4-mile shape at world (0,0) with worldAnchor (1e9,1e9). The local one-mile card and marker use the anchor, while coarse summaries use the physical shape, so the owner appears at an unrelated location or outside the map.
findings.expected: Reject shape/anchor inconsistency atomically, or require explicit reviewed anchor repair; do not silently move anchor.

findings.description: For representative sizes below one mile, placement uses a fine-cell segment start as the route entry. A tower of diameter 0.03 miles at world (12,0) receives accepted road entry (11.5,0), half a mile away; the validator accepts it.
findings.expected: Saved entrance should correspond to the accepted object anchor or actual explicit geometry. Clarify whether small catalogue estimates intentionally provide no physical contract; GRID-C09 requires a valid entry in the real object geometry.
